game_concept: A puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor, a corridor of glyphs: the relic hunter must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the relic hunter's backpack list as cursed statues drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor: a corridor of glyphs
core_gameplay_loop: In Glyph Corridor, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the relic hunter's backpack list as cursed statues drop loot. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bag_space value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the spirit lantern using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The spirit lantern reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the spirit lantern is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Backpack Append' (Week 7 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Glyph Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bag_space changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Glyph Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The spirit lantern reached with actions_used <= 21.
